name.ja: ケロロ軍曹プラモコレクション　クルル曹長
name.en: Keroro Sergeant Plastic Model Collection Sergeant Krul

description.ja: TVアニメ「ケロロ軍曹」に登場するちょっと陰湿な発明家“クルル曹長”がプラモデル化 。
description.en: The slightly insidious inventor "Sergeant Major Kururu " who appears in the TV anime " Sergeant Keroro" has been made into a plastic model.

description.ja: 腕と足のパーツが複数付属、差し替えでさまざまなアクションポーズを再現可能 。
description.en: Multiple arm and leg parts are included, allowing you to recreate various action poses by replacing them.

description.ja: 目は回転ギミックで表情が変化。
description.en: The eyes have a rotating gimmick and their expressions change.
